current_news.title: Gordon sends his final supplemental budget to lawmakers as December hearings near
current_news.summary: Gov. Mark Gordon released a $527 million supplemental budget request on Nov. 16. It includes $16.6 million to extend property tax relief and $100 million for permanent savings. The Joint Appropriations Committee hears it Dec. 7-11. Secretary of State-elect Robert Short named Cara Boyle Chambers as his deputy.

archive.title: New leaders chosen for the 69th Legislature as Governor-elect Barlow builds his team
archive.summary: Legislative caucuses picked new leaders on Nov. 14: Sen. Tara Nethercott for Senate President and Rep. Lloyd Larsen for House Speaker. The Legislative Service Office listed standing-committee chairs and members on Nov. 18. Governor-elect Eric Barlow named his chief of staff and attorney general nominee on Nov. 10. He takes office Jan. 4. The session opens Jan. 12.

archive.title: Interim committees finish bill drafts before the 2027 General Session
archive.summary: Panels finish drafts before Jan. 12. Education meets Nov. 17. Blockchain meets Nov. 19-20. Council meets Nov. 23.

archive.title: Certified election results set the calendar for the 2027 Legislature
archive.summary: The board certified the Nov. 3 results on Nov. 10. Officers take office Jan. 4, 2027. The Legislature convenes Jan. 12.
